release_notes: The v2.14.0 features (user logins, POS quick-pick tiles, petty cash, payment methods, deposits, repair price list, matrix notes) crashed or stayed empty on cloud-synced shops: their new tables never reach a replica automatically. All tables have been applied to the cloud, **and** the app now self-heals — if a needed table is missing it is created on the spot from the built-in schema and the action simply succeeds. This class of error can't come back for future features.; The part-type filter chips in the Counter's SELL view were clipped to half height whenever they overflowed (the scrollbar ate into the row). The chip row now reserves space for a slim scrollbar below the chips, and the Favorites chip uses a proper star icon instead of an emoji.
